supporting_article_titles: Quality Teams Need AI That Builds Inspectors, Not Just Faster Inspections
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Industrial quality teams are using AI not only to accelerate inspection work but to preserve and transfer inspector judgment.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: inspection finding → expert reasoning → training/coaching → competency evidence
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: capture expert inspection judgment and turn it into repeatable coaching for newer inspectors
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Inspection know-how remains concentrated in experienced staff and is difficult to transfer consistently.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: case-based inspection learning ledger with finding, expert rationale, trainee decision, review and competency history
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A web workspace that converts real inspection decisions into reusable inspector training evidence.
raw_opportunities.why_now: AI-assisted quality work creates an opportunity to redirect saved time into structured inspector capability building.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Manufacturing quality and inspector-training workflows are transferable to factories in the Trakya industrial corridor; local customer evidence requires validation.

supporting_article_titles: Apple changes full-disk access permissions to curb abuse from AI agents
Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: More autonomous desktop agents make broad OS permissions materially riskier, prompting tighter user-understanding and access controls.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: agent onboarding → permission request → approval → periodic review → revocation evidence
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: prove that each agent has only justified permissions and that users understood the access granted
raw_opportunities.current_friction: OS permissions are coarse and organizational approval evidence is often detached from the actual agent deployment.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: agent permission inventory + business justification + owner approval + review/revocation ledger
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A permission-governance register for enterprise desktop AI agents.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Apple explicitly linked stronger Full Disk Access controls to increasingly capable autonomous agents.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Directly transferable to manufacturing, warehouse and distribution operations in Trakya; local evidence must be verified before Lüleburgaz scope.
